verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party Trust Center product describes the core of this story. It is a branded portal with docs and live controls that automates access approvals and NDAs (vanta-docs-88). Vanta positions it as automating security reviews and giving prospects what they need to make a purchase decision (vanta-docs-19). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of public hosting and click-through NDA mechanics (vs. generic NDA automation), specific mention of certifications/audit reports as shareable artifacts, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
